parameters.query:
SELECT source_key,
       source_name,
       source_platform,
       signal_origin,
       fetch_type,
       endpoint,
       COALESCE(extra_config, '{}'::jsonb) AS extra_config
FROM public.source_registry
WHERE is_active = TRUE
ORDER BY priority;

parameters.query:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT id FROM tech_news WHERE url = $${{ $json.url }}$$ LIMIT 1),
        (SELECT id FROM tech_news_failed WHERE url = $${{ $json.url }}$$ LIMIT 1)
    ) as existing_id,
    
    $${{ $json.url }}$$ as url,
    $${{ $json.title }}$$ as title,
    {{ $json.points || 0 }} as points

UPDATE tech_news
SET 
    points = {{ $json.points }},
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE url = $${{ $json.url }}$$
RETURNING id;
